coordinates.note: No source consulted (checked 2026-09-17) gives a surveyed lat/lon for the KTeV hall on the Fermilab fixed-target beamlines. The point recorded is the one used for the Fermilab main campus, with a precision of 3 km and uncertain confidence. Treat it as campus precision, not hall precision.

name: KTeV experimental hall, Fermilab
notes: The coordinates reuse the Fermilab main-campus point rather than a separate lookup; see the coordinate note.

summary.plain: The Fermilab experimental hall where the KTeV experiment studied rare kaon decays and CP violation in the 1990s.
summary.technical: Fixed-target experimental hall on the Fermilab site (Batavia, Illinois) housing the KTeV (E799-II/E832) kaon spectrometer; no surveyed coordinate for this specific hall was found, so the Fermilab campus point is used at reduced precision.
